meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会深度解释 senpi 提示：先运行 senpi --list-tips 查询实时列表，读取你的设置确认实际可见的提示，再核对功能代码，最后用你的语言给出含机制和文件路径的详解。
howto.when: 当你说出“give-me-tips”、询问某条 Tip: 行的含义，或想知道某个提示功能如何工作时触发。

say.text: 给我讲讲刚才那条 Tip: 行的意思
say.note: Claude 会先查询实时列表再深入解释。
直接触发本技能开始解释提示。

say.text: 我能看到哪些提示？为什么只有这些？
say.note: Claude 会检查你的设置和可用性，列出实际可见提示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude explains senpi tips in depth: it runs `senpi --list-tips` to fetch the live tip list, reads your settings to confirm which tips you can actually see, verifies against the real feature code, then explains in your language with concrete mechanics and file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'give-me-tips', ask what a Tip: line means, or want to know how a tipped feature works.

say_en.text: Tell me what that Tip: line means.
say_en.note: Claude queries the live tip list and explains in depth.
Triggers this skill to start explaining tips.

say_en.text: What tips can I see and why only these?
say_en.note: Claude checks your settings and lists what you can see.
